title: BH-5354.2: merge-queue batch runs only changed-fingerprint suites
body:
Wire CI, and above all the merge-queue batch, to the suite ledger the contract child landed: a batch runs only the suites whose input fingerprint changed, plus the always-suites, and reuses CI-recorded greens for the rest. Parent plan section S5 and interpretations I1, I2, I4 (`/root/harness/builds/cromford-BH-5354-202610080134/plan.md`).

Imports from the contract: `bin/suite-reuse.sh plan|record` (class `ci`, curl transport with `SUITE_LEDGER_URL` + `x-suite-ledger-token`, `record --from-gate-log`). This child does not edit `bin/suite-reuse.sh`, `bin/lib/suite-fingerprint.sh`, `bin/test-impact.sh` or any worker file.

## Scope
- `bin/ci-plan.sh`, after the tier step and before sizing: when `CI_PLAN_REUSED_FILE` is set (a shard), subtract it with no network call. Otherwise, when `CI_PLAN_REUSE=1` and the path is eligible (a batch whose escalation is not the `full` label or `unmapped:`; a push-to-main full corpus), call `bin/suite-reuse.sh plan --class ci --ctx "$CI_REUSE_CTX"` and subtract. `--expect-n` compares the same reduced list. New outputs `reused`, `saved_s`, `reuse` (`on`, `off: <why>`, `-`). The existing `SUMMARY` line keeps its exact shape (`impact: N of M suites (...)`); reuse is a separate `reuse: ...` line, a `::notice` and the step summary. The `full` label, `workflow_dispatch` and the nightly tier NEVER look up.
- `.github/workflows/harness-ci.yml`: plan job env `CI_PLAN_REUSE: '1'`, `CI_REUSE_CTX: ${{ vars.CI_RUNNER }}`, `SUITE_LEDGER_URL: ${{ vars.SUITE_LEDGER_URL }}`, `SUITE_LEDGER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUITE_LEDGER_TOKEN }}`, uploads artifact `suite-reuse-plan` (`fingerprints.tsv`, `reused.tsv`). `tests-shard` downloads it (missing -> `CI_PLAN_REUSED_FILE` unset and `CI_PLAN_REUSE=0`, so `--expect-n` goes red rather than silently skipping); the trace step tees to `$RUNNER_TEMP/gate.log` under `set -o pipefail` so its rc is unchanged; new step `record suite results` (`if: always()`, token in THIS step's env only) runs `bin/suite-reuse.sh record --from-gate-log`, run key `<run_id>-<attempt>-<shard>`, url = the run URL; shard 0 also records the run row with the plan's reused list. `decisions` prints the reuse line next to `PLAN_SUMMARY`. Ordinary-PR jobs get no token. `bin/ci-verdicts.sh` is unchanged.
- `.github/workflows/harness-nightly.yml`: record only (class `ci`), never `plan`. Its `MISS` lines are the impact-map signal.
- Header comments in the workflow and `bin/ci-plan.sh`: which suites a green covers when some were reused, and that a reused suite was traced clean on the run that recorded it.
- Edit `tests/harness-ci-cost-shape-test.sh` / `tests/ci-plan-test.sh` only where this changes a pinned behavior by design; never append cases to them.
- Docs: `docs/verification-map/entries/BH-5354.2.md` (own entry: the `reuse:` plan line, the record step, and that builder rows never satisfy CI).
- PR body: the env/secret rollout (GitHub secret `SUITE_LEDGER_TOKEN`, repo variable `SUITE_LEDGER_URL`, worker secret `SUITE_LEDGER_TOKEN`; unset anywhere = reuse off, nothing breaks), the residual trust risk from the plan's edge cases, and that the builder -> batch repeat remains (I1).

## Files
`bin/ci-plan.sh`, `.github/workflows/harness-ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/harness-nightly.yml`, `docs/verification-map/entries/BH-5354.2.md`; new tests `tests/ci-plan-reuse.bh-5354-test.sh`, `tests/harness-ci-reuse-shape.bh-5354-test.sh`.

## Acceptance tests this child owns
- C1: scratch repo with suites S1/S2/S3 reading area1/2/3 and always suite SA, ledger stub seeded with `ok` `ci` rows for the base tree's fingerprints (`sfp_compute` on the base). Batch head = base + PR1 (area1) + PR2 (area2), as `CI_EVENT=pull_request TI_PR_HEAD_REF=mergify/merge-queue/x` with an escalation that keeps reuse on -> planned list {S1, S2, SA}, S3 reused. Same in batch-selected mode.
- C2: a shard with `CI_PLAN_REUSED_FILE` from C1 -> same list, `--expect-n` agrees, zero stub curl calls.
- C3: the `full` label, an `unmapped:` escalation, `workflow_dispatch` and `--tier nightly` -> no lookup, full list.
- C4: batch with no token -> same list and N as without reuse, output `reuse=off: no credential`.
- C5: a filter that would empty the list -> reuse dropped, full list, note printed.
- S1 (shape): `secrets.SUITE_LEDGER_TOKEN` only in the plan job env and the record step env; record step is `if: always()`; trace step keeps its command and pipefail rc; nightly has a record step and no `plan` call; ordinary-PR jobs get no token.
- Must stay green unchanged: `tests/ci-plan-batch-impact.bh-4968-test.sh`, `tests/ci-plan-batch-member-label.bh-4969-test.sh`, `tests/ci-plan-spa-worker.bh-4969-test.sh`, `tests/ci-shard-split-test.sh`, `tests/ci-verdicts-test.sh`, `tests/dedicated-job-coverage-test.sh`, `tests/harness-ci-trigger.bh-861-test.sh`, `tests/harness-ci-runners.bh-1206-test.sh`, `tests/harness-ci-runners.bh-1323-test.sh`.

## Observable outcome
C1 in `tests/ci-plan-reuse.bh-5354-test.sh`: `bin/ci-plan.sh` on a merge-queue batch of two PRs touching unrelated areas plans exactly {S1, S2, SA}, prints `reuse: ... reused 1 ...` with S3 named as reused from its recorded run, and the shard re-plan from the uploaded `reused.tsv` (C2) agrees on N with no ledger call.
